'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Bakhmut]]
***[[Wagner Group]] leader [[Yevgeny Prigozhin]] says that they have captured all of [[Bakhmut]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]]. The [[Ministry of Defence (Ukraine)|Ukrainian Defence Ministry]] rejects this claim, saying that its forces still control a district on the westernmost edge of the city. **At least twelve people are killed and dozens more are injured in a [[crowd crush]] at the [[Estadio Cuscatlán]] [[association football|football]] [[stadium]] in [[San Salvador]], [[El Salvador]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-65662194.amp (BBC News)]

*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Ensenada shootout]]
***Gunmen [[mass shooting|open fire]] during a [[car racing]] show in [[Ensenada, Baja California]], [[Mexico]], killing ten people and injuring nine others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/least-10-people-killed-nine-injured-shootout-northern-mexico-2023-05-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022–23 Premier League]]
**[[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] win their third consecutive [[Premier League]] title after title contenders [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] lose 1–0 to [[Nottingham Forest F.C.|Nottingham Forest]] at the [[City Ground]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/65613744 (BBC Sport)]
*[[2023 Preakness Stakes]]
**The 2023 [[Preakness Stakes]] is won by [[National Treasure (horse)|National Treasure]], who was trained by [[Bob Baffert]], who had returned after a two-year absence caused by a suspension due to [[Medina Spirit]]'s disqualification and subsequent death in 2021. The [[2023 Kentucky Derby]] winner, [[Mage (horse)|Mage]], finishes third.
